products.name: Fusion Artisan Mushroom Chocolate Bar (6g)
products.headline: Foil boutique chocolate bars with the flavor name on the wrapper
products.shortDescription: The Fusion chocolate bar, photographed flavor by flavor on the Fusion Bars shop. The mark sits in the centre and the flavor name sits at the lower right.
products.description: Each Fusion bar is a foil sleeve with the Fusion mark in the centre and the flavor name at the lower right. The back panel carries a QR code so the sleeve can be checked against the genuine pack. Fusion Bars EU dispatches these bars from Europe in discreet, temperature-guarded packaging. The 10-bar boutique box holds one each of ten flavors. For any other mix, write the flavors in the order note at checkout.
products.reviewNotes: Standardized EU culinary formulation verified. Unsupported medical/psychoactive claims stripped.
